summary: The diff adds frontend CSV export utilities and updates roll-call hooks/pages to call backend APIs, plus introduces a migration module and some backend type/state scaffolding. However, key backend requirements (Class 8/9 lookup fix, upgrade-safe stable persistence, and confirmed roll-call persistence/query APIs) are not clearly implemented in the provided diff summary, and the CSV export output is missing required class/section fields. Several unrelated UI/features and at least one constraint-violating change (editing frontend/src/main.tsx) appear in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix backend student lookup so Class 8/9 (any section) returns existing students via getClassSectionStudents, and Class 8/9 students show on StudentListPage and AttendancePage without re-adding.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo changes are truncated at getClassSectionStudents implementation; no explicit evidence shows the Class 8/9 lookup bug was fixed or that retrieval logic differs from prior behavior.

missing_requirements.requirement: Make student storage resilient to canister upgrades (restore indexes/counters and continue ID counter after upgrade).
missing_requirements.reason: A migration module is added, but there is no evidence of stable variables or preupgrade/postupgrade logic that actually persists/restores students, indexes, roll calls, or idCounter across upgrades; migration.run currently returns old unchanged (old;).
evidence: backend/main.mo (shows '(with migration = Migration.run)' but no stable persistence shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend roll-call persistence APIs to save daily roll call and query by day and by month/class/section, with persistence across refresh and upgrade.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.getDailyRollCall, actor.submitRollCall, and actor.getMonthlyClassSectionRollCall, but the diff summary does not show these methods implemented in backend/main.mo (file content is truncated and no method definitions are visible). Also no upgrade persistence is evidenced for rollCalls.
evidence: backend/migration.mo (no persistence logic; returns old state unchanged)

missing_requirements.requirement: Monthly export CSV must include class and section along with student name, roll number, and attendance values for the month.
missing_requirements.reason: generateMonthlyAttendanceCsv builds headers/data with Roll No, Student Name, Parent Mobile, Day columns, totals and percent, but does not include class or section columns.
